patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — GoTo Connect and Zenzap share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Comparison thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs. Choose GoTo Connect only if your buying job matches “Remote-team UCaaS phone system with meetings and messaging — Phone System / CX / Contact C” rather than Zenzap's shape. Choose Zenzap only if your buying job matches “Professional work-chat app for frontline and multi-site teams replacing WhatsApp groups — ” rather than GoTo Connect's shape. Workflow advantage: GoTo Connect leans business-phone, contact-center; Zenzap leans shared coverage. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — GoTo Connect and Zenzap share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: GoTo Connect is Remote-team UCaaS phone system with meetings and messaging — Phone System / CX / Contact Center ladders are custom-quote (no public seat dol; Zenzap is Professional work-chat app for frontline and multi-site teams replacing WhatsApp groups — free tier, Pro $3/user/month yearly, Business+ $8 .
- Company-size focus: GoTo Connect (small-business, mid-market) vs Zenzap (micro, small-business, mid-market).
- Workflow coverage skew: GoTo Connect-leaning business-phone, contact-center vs Zenzap-leaning —.
- Researched limits: GoTo Connect — No published self-serve seat dollars — every plan is sales-quoted; Zenzap — Integrations with other business tools and API access require Business+.

Limitations — GoTo Connect: No published self-serve seat dollars — every plan is sales-quoted; Industry dollar ranges are low confidence and must not be treated as list prices; Zenzap: Integrations with other business tools and API access require Business+; Voice and video calls require Pro; call recording and transcription require Business+.

Poor-fit cases: GoTo Connect is a poor fit when that limitation bites: No published self-serve seat dollars — every plan is sales-quoted · Zenzap is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Integrations with other business tools and API access require Business+ · Avoid GoTo Connect if you actually need Zenzap's motion (Professional work-chat app for frontline and multi-site teams replacing WhatsApp)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
